records.question: How many virtual coins was each participating group given to place in the prioritization grid?
records.ground_truth_answer: Each participating group was given 50 virtual coins (n=50), calculated as 30% of the total number of grid cells.
ground_truth_chunks: Each participating group was given a separate set of virtual coins (n=50), calculated as 30% of the total number of grid cells, to place in the prioritization grid to indicate the locations and importance of their mapping needs.

records.question: What percentage of coins overall were assigned to mesoscale, microscale, and regional Map Product Requirement spatial scales?
ground_truth_chunks: The percentage of the coins overall revealed data at the mesoscale were selected most often (45%), followed by microscale (36%) and regional scale (19%) data (Figure 8).
Regional data were only selected at the primary level, with all three scales selected equally at this level (33%).

records.question: How many clusters of cells contained five to six (top 10%) different Management Uses selected by participants?
records.ground_truth_answer: There were two clusters of cells.
ground_truth_chunks: There were only two clusters of cells that contained five to six (top 10%) different Management Uses selected by participants.

The largest group of top 10% cells was on the island of Tutuila, and although these six cells are adjacent they actually represent two distinctly different areas. Five cells extend across Pago Pago Harbor on the South shore and one cell was within Vatia Bay, along the North shore.

records.question: On Tutuila, where did the top 10% summary rank clusters and single top 10% cells occur?
records.ground_truth_answer: Top 10% summary rank clusters occurred in Pago Pago Harbor (six cells) and in Pala Lagoon (three cells) near Nu'uuli. Single top 10% cells occurred in Larsen Bay and Leone on Tutuila.
ground_truth_chunks: Two top 10% summary rank clusters occurred on Tutuila in Pago Pago Harbor (six cells) and in Pala Lagoon (three cells) near Nu'uuli.
Single top 10% cells were located in Larsen Bay and Leone on Tutuila and off Fatuana Point, south Ofu.

records.question: Which area is American Samoa's largest estuary and has the largest mangrove swamp (Nu'uuli Pala) in the territory?
ground_truth_chunks: Pala Lagoon, the only other cluster of top 10% summary rank cells (three), also on Tutuila, is American Samoa's largest estuary and has the largest mangrove swamp (known as Nu'uuli Pala) in the territory (Gilman et al., 2007; Dobson et al., 2021).
